component.name: legal-rag-audit
component.description: Endpoint-based evaluation harness for legal RAG systems — 'score' dependency layer

components.name: gen_sbom.py
components.description: generates this document from requirements/*.txt; see scripts/gen_sbom.py

properties.name: legal-rag-audit:serial-number-derivation
properties.value: uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'https://github.com/azterizm/legal-rag-audit/sbom/score#<sha256 of the lockfile>') — derived rather than random so this document can be regenerated byte-for-byte and checked against the lockfile it describes

properties.name: legal-rag-audit:timestamp-omitted
properties.value: metadata.timestamp is deliberately absent: a generation time would change on every run and make drift undetectable. The build time of a released artefact is recorded in its SLSA provenance attestation instead

properties.name: legal-rag-audit:licences-not-recorded
properties.value: component licences are not listed. A lockfile carries no licence metadata, and reading it from installed distributions would make this document depend on the machine that generated it. Stated rather than silently omitted

properties.name: legal-rag-audit:hash-scope
properties.value: each hash is one distribution file (a platform wheel or the sdist), not one hash of one artefact — this is what --require-hashes verifies
